name: @oaverify/stream
description: Streaming OpenAPI / JSON Schema 2020-12 validator. Validates a JSON body as it streams with bounded memory for multi-GB payloads, echoing bytes through unchanged while reporting violations on a side channel. Built on @oaverify/core.
author: Andrew Houghton <aah@roarmouse.org>

scripts.prepack: node -e "if((process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'').startsWith('npm/'))throw Error('Use pnpm pack: npm pack does not rewrite workspace:* deps.')" && tsup && node ../../scripts/pack-devdeps.mjs strip
